name: factory
description: DataCraft software factory: Runway, a deterministic loop that runs a repo's ready tickets (Linear or GitHub Issues, one per repo, chosen in runway.json) unattended in git worktrees, preps decision packets for the ones that need Joe, and finishes with a review and a PR body. The runway skill sets up a repo, plans its tickets with Matt Pocock's skills, labels them with the gating rule and runs the loop on a schedule. Pairs with the pm plugin (credential guard, gates).
